affected.note: Maximum figure from the second report (2026-10-26) for the member information database server; the company says these are records that may have leaked, not a confirmed count. Separately, up to about 230,000 records of the Joshin subscription service (including initial login passwords and handwritten signature data) and up to about 800 records of a renovation photo upload system (including a few license, My Number card and bank account images) may have leaked. Card data is not held.

summary.en: Electronics retailer Joshin detected an anomaly on its network on 2026-10-16 and found traces of unauthorized access, which forced it to suspend some services. Its second report said names, addresses, phone numbers and member numbers of up to about 6 million records in its member database may have leaked.
summary.ja: 家電量販店のJoshinは2026年10月16日に社内ネットワークの異常を検知し、不正アクセスの形跡を確認したため一部サービスを停止した。第2報では、会員情報データベースの氏名、住所、電話番号、会員番号の最大約600万件が漏洩した可能性があるとした。
